issues.title: Client crash on `Create clean copy`
issues.body:
A Game Control is trying to create a duplicate of a wargame from the Admin page.

The `Clean copy` process should copy a wargame, but delete all messages, and just have the wargame description, in a non-initiated state.  Note: Ian doesn't think the flaw is in this logic.

He used `Clean copy` from a wargame's context menu.

A blank screen was shown.

Here is the client-side error log:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/121380244-9f22a280-c93c-11eb-9a5d-50e2f776a09a.png)

There is a _chance_ that this issue is related to us starting to append `.sqlite` file suffix to wargames.  When we join a wargame as a player, or when we open a wargame for editing, then the correct filename is found.  But, when we run `Clean Copy` it fails.

Or, maybe... The duplicate wargame is created, but we try to access it before it is physically available.
